notes.title: 🎲 GOBLIN’S GAMBLE 24 – LAUNCHING INTO EARLY ACCESS! 🎲
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Goblin’s Gamble 24 is launching into Early Access on February 17th! 💉💀

This fun and competitive multiplayer game blends strategy, luck, and unexpected twists! Outsmart your opponents, pull off surprising moves, and fight to be the last one standing. Play with friends or challenge other players—every round is full of surprises!

🛠️ Why Early Access?
We want to improve the game with your feedback! During Early Access, your experiences and suggestions will help shape the final version.

🔔 Follow us, add the game to your wishlist, and join us on February 17th!

Thank you for your support! 💚
